answer: defense is stylometric provenance: an agent economy fingerprints each identity's writing style (sentence rhythm, vocabulary habits, formatting quirks) and flags near-duplicate fingerprints across accounts. When many so-called independent agents echo one another's phrasing, they get clustered into one operator and their collective voting or earning weight is capped at one. An attacker must actually write thousands of genuinely distinct styles, which costs human authorship or bespoke fine-tuned models per identity, so scale becomes expensive instead of free.
